citations.claim: NS turned green with 0s all-red violation, emergency active
EW was in yellow immediately before violation, about to need 4s all-red
Normal EW green before emergency preemption

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=126; without preemption the controller respects the 4s all-red and no violation occurs, proving emergency preemption is the cause.

explanation: At step 126 EW was in yellow, at step 127 NS turned green with 0s all-red despite all_red_seconds=4. The emergency on N starting at t=126 caused immediate preemption from EW yellow directly to NS green, skipping the mandatory all-red clearance. Removing the emergency restores normal cycle with proper clearance.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 4 s)

vision_note: At steps 124-125 the East-West approaches show green while North-South shows red, then at step 126 both active directions turn yellow. At step 127 the opposite North-South direction turns green immediately with no intervening all-red where all signals are red.
